The m-aware shapefile can be downloaded from here.\n\nThe purpose of this layer is to identify and label the measure of SLK along a particular route, at a particular scale, and is provided for information only. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
